Welcome to Rampur Anchalik College
And seeing ignorance is the curse of god
Knowledge the wing wherewith we fly to heaven
-William Shakespeare.henry VI
Man is the wisest of all animals by virtue of only one thing his extraordinary power of thinking and emotion except knowledge all other animals have the same basis necessities as man has in other words we can say that man’s basis necessities are four food shelter covering and education Education provides the adequate knowledge to human beings to lead a sound and peaceful life A college is the hub of knowledge that can and should indulge in present of knowledge and truth uplifting human values in a nation building operation for social change education particularly higher education has invariably been considered an important vehicle no country no nation can claim of sharing a global platform if it lags behind in the field of education  knowledge and often spiritual one can invaluably be considered an important vehicle of loading a sound life.
Keeping in view all these errands Rampur Anchalik College was established in 1996 by a constellation of knowledge seekers of greater Rampur area of Kamrup district under the leadership of the then cabinet Minister education department Government of Assam. Sjt Jatin Mali and I would like to revere those great personalities who masterminded to erect Rampur Anchalik college in this rural set up of Rampur.
Rampur anchalik college has been at the vanguard of a diverse friendly learning community since 1996 where students progress well in their studies in an amicable atmosphere we have been trying to impart value based education in the rural youth of greater Rampur area we encourage all over students to develop high expectations about themselves. There work and their behavior which is an expression of our value of personal best integrity Respect and Responsibility in in addition to these. We cater for good employability we extent our cordial greeting to those well wishers who come forward with inspired suggestions.
A warm welcome to Rampur Anchalik College
Principal's Desk
Dr. Dinamani Kalita

Welcome to Rampur Anchalik College
Located at Rampur on the south bank of kamrup, Assam, Rampur Anchalik College was founded on the 20th day of august way back in 1996 the college stands on the left/north of the N.H 37 some 30-35 kilometers westward from guwahati ours is one of as few as three college under the greater area of palashbari legislative assemble constituency affiliated to gauhati university though just 200 meters away from the N.H 37. The College is hardly subject to the traffic noise instead it is possessed of a quiet teaching learning Activity friendly environment in green pleasant surroundings.
                            This long sought after public institute of higher education in the greater Rampur locality is unmistakably an optimistic outcome of the yeomen’s service rendered by a body of a good few aspiring enterprising and knowledge..
